name: Esoteric Plate
summary: Black on warm paper, a thick top bar, a condensed sans and a mono, one breakpoint, fluid type with a floor. The reference for a page that is already good on a phone: nothing shrunk to fit.

for: pages where the type is the design
not_for: pages that need a status palette

shape.note: hard edges; one 8px bar at the top; fluid type via clamp() with a floor, one breakpoint at 760px

signature.name: the bar and the rule
signature.rule: An 8px black bar across the top and ruled lines in place of boxes; emphasis is weight and case, never colour.
signature.carries: the page's structure: every rule is a section boundary and every bar is a masthead

motifs.rule: clamp() with a floor of 12 to 15px; never add a breakpoint to reduce a size.

never: a second breakpoint added to shrink type

provenance.source_run: SolutionsAsService/esoteric-languages (the mobile-good reference in dada's mobile standard)
measured: Mobile Floor 12 of 12 on all 17 pages (check_floor.py)
open: the owner graded its mobile behaviour only, not the whole design
no status vocabulary: a page that needs one should not use this pack alone
